dataset.name: MIMIC-IV
dataset.access: Credentialed PhysioNet access and the MIMIC data-use agreement are required.

icu/procedureevents.csv.gz.uses: Intermittent HD index procedures and CRRT-at-start exclusion

icu/chartevents.csv.gz.uses: Pre-index SBP/DBP/heart rate and post-start SBP endpoints

prediction_time.tie_rule: Closest/latest charttime; NIBP wins an exact SBP or DBP timestamp tie

outcome.primary_provenance: Historical operational broad 20--350 mm Hg individual-SBP screen followed by a 50--250 mm Hg selected-nadir eligibility rule
outcome.sensitivity: Per-measurement 50--250 mm Hg screening before nadir selection

split.assignment: fold 0 locked test; fold 1 validation; folds 2--4 train
split.historical_crrt_at_start_rule: crrt_start <= T0 <= crrt_end; the end-equality case is retained solely to reproduce the pre-existing split ledger
split.historical_stratification_variable: nadir SBP <90 mm Hg when pre-dialysis SBP <160 mm Hg, otherwise nadir SBP <100 mm Hg; retained verbatim for the sole purpose of reproducing the pre-existing patient-disjoint fold assignment. It is neither the analysis outcome nor the seven-day history event, both of which are Nadir90 (nadir SBP <90 mm Hg).

score.probability_mapping: Published score probability equation; no MIMIC refit
score.uf_bw_policy: Structurally unavailable; current frozen +4 missing branch
score.history_policy: Count prior-session post-start nadir SBP below 90 mm Hg among observable primary-eligible HD sessions in the preceding seven calendar days; primary eligibility requires pre-SBP and selected nadir 50--250 mm Hg, at least one post-start SBP, positive duration, and no CRRT at T0; no observable prior labelled HD remains missing

privacy.public_outputs: Aggregate counts, metrics, contracts, and hashes only
privacy.prohibited_outputs: MIMIC identifiers, session-level features, outcomes, scores, probabilities, or predictions
